findings.title: Do not gate conditional passkeys on an identified user
findings.body: This helper is used to decide whether to call `fillContextForm` both when initially rendering the login form and when re-rendering it after an error. Requiring a non-null user prevents those calls for an unauthenticated login, so the form gets no WebAuthn challenge or conditional-mediation configuration and discoverable passkeys cannot log the user in. Passkey discovery must work before the user is identified.
